Ava (Partnerships): Heads up — GCP Marketplace PO ack doesn't include our billing_affinity field, vendor says it's 'by design'. This blocks automation for finance.
Ravi (Marketplace): Ugh. Which field exactly? example?
Ava (Partnerships): It's the <billing_affinity> tag in the PO XML. sample:
```
<PurchaseOrder>
  <PONumber>PO-12345</PONumber>
  <!-- missing <billing_affinity> -->
</PurchaseOrder>
```
Sofia (Revenue Ops): We rely on that to route invoices to committed-account entities. Without it finance has to manual-match, can't meet month-end close.
Liam (Legal): Is the vendor refusing due to scope/contract? Did we share the MSA billing mapping appendix?
Ravi (Marketplace): Vendor says standard GCP ack schema omits that field. Their marketplace integration team says we should use the 'customAttributes' map instead.
Ava (Partnerships): They offered 'customAttributes' but it won't be surfaced in our ledger import — engineering would need mapping change. That breaks Dedicated onboarding flows too.
Sofia (Revenue Ops): Short term: can we have partner send a separate CSV with PO -> billing_entity? Not great but could be stopgap.
IntegrationsBot: ACTION created: #ticket-6421 to eng-infra for 'PO customAttributes -> billing_affinity mapping'.
Ravi (Marketplace): I'll push partner for a dev doc and a feature flaged change. @Liam can we get a redline that requires billing_affinity or equivalent in acknowledgements for future deals?
Liam (Legal): I can propose MSA amendment language: require either billing_affinity element or a mapped customAttribute with agreed key 'redwood_billing_affinity'. I'll draft.
Ava (Partnerships): Thanks. Short-term: @Sofia can you confirm finance can accept CSV for this week's close? If yes, we'll roll that while eng builds mapping.
Sofia (Revenue Ops): Can do CSV for this month if partner commits to send it daily. Send template and we'll validate.
Ravi (Marketplace): Partner agreed to daily CSV for 2 weeks. I'll attach to ticket. Keeping this open — will update when eng has ETA. :thumbsup:
